title: Medical Records Requests Chart of Protected Information Categories
content:
Four categories of information in a Medical Records Requests release are governed by per-type settings: separately kept psychotherapy notes, substance-use-disorder treatment records, HIV, genetic-testing and sexual-health results, and a minor's confidential adolescent services when a parent makes the request.

| Request type | Separately kept psychotherapy notes released | Substance-use-disorder treatment records need a specific consent naming the recipient | HIV, genetic-testing and sexual-health results need a specific consent | Confidential adolescent services excluded from a parent's request absent the minor's consent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Legal Records Package | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | No | Yes | No | Yes |

Psychotherapy notes that are kept separately are never released without a specific authorization, and no request type releases them.

## Reading the chart

- **Constant across all seven types:** psychotherapy notes kept separately are not released, and substance-use-disorder treatment records need a specific consent naming the recipient.
- **Specific consent for HIV, genetic-testing and sexual-health results** is required on the Provider-to-Provider Transfer, the Third-Party Authorized Release and the Certified Legal Records Package, and not on the other four types.
- **The adolescent exclusion** applies on every type except the Provider-to-Provider Transfer.
